# vulnetix_github_installation_repos (Data Source)

The repositories the tenant's active GitHub App installations reach (`GET /integrations/github/installations/repos`), ordered by full name. It reads Vulnetix's cache, which GitHub webhooks keep current, so a plan never calls GitHub. Use `full_names` to scope a `vulnetix_vex_source` or a `vulnetix_jail_policy` to every repository the App can see.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every repository the Vulnetix GitHub App can see in the acme organisation,
# archived ones left out.
data "vulnetix_github_installation_repos" "acme" {
  query = "acme/"
}

# Apply the security team's VEX statements to all of them.
resource "vulnetix_vex_source" "advisories" {
  name = "acme-advisories"
  scope = {
    repos = data.vulnetix_github_installation_repos.acme.full_names
  }
  git = {
    url   = "https://github.com/acme/security-advisories.git"
    ref   = "main"
    paths = ["vex/**/*.openvex.json"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Keep archived repositories. Defaults to `false`.
- `installation_id` (Number) Only this installation's repositories.
- `query` (String) Only repositories whose `owner/name` contains this, ignoring case.

### Read-Only

- `full_names` (List of String) The repositories' `owner/name`, in order.
- `repos` (Attributes List) The matching repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repos))

<a id="nestedatt--repos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repos`

Read-Only:

- `account_login` (String) The account the App is installed on.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the repository is archived.
- `full_name` (String) `owner/name`.
- `host` (String) The GitHub host, such as `github.com`.
- `installation_id` (Number) The GitHub App installation that reaches it.
- `name` (String) The repository's name.
- `owner_login` (String) The repository's owner.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether the repository is private.
- `repo_id` (Number) GitHub's repository id.
- `updated_at` (Number) When Vulnetix last refreshed the row, in Unix milliseconds.
